leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize React state to track the current page and total items for pagination
Implement a function to calculate the total number of pages based on items per page
Construct a component that renders pagination controls with previous/next buttons
Configure event handlers to update the current page when users click pagination buttons
Manipulate array data to display only the items for the current page
Integrate pagination logic with a list component to display paginated content
Render dynamic page number buttons that update based on the current page range
